AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
| where ResourceProvider has "GOOGLE"
| extend props = parse_json(tostring(Properties))
| extend principal = tostring(props.principalEmail)
| extend accessedProject = tostring(props.projectId)
| extend svc = tostring(props.serviceName)
| extend method = tostring(props.methodName)
| extend resource = tostring(props.resourceName)
| where principal matches regex @"service-(\d+)@gcp-sa-aiplatform\.iam\.gserviceaccount\.com" or principal matches regex @"(\d+)-compute@developer\.gserviceaccount\.com"
| extend tokenProject = coalesce(extract(@"service-(\d+)@gcp-sa-aiplatform", 1, principal), extract(@"(\d+)-compute@developer", 1, principal))
| where isnotempty(tokenProject) and tokenProject != accessedProject
| project TimeGenerated, principal, tokenProject, accessedProject, svc, method, resource
| order by TimeGenerated desc

| where (FileName in~ ("node.js", "mscoree.dll", "msvcp140.dll"))

description: Detects creation or modification of a Google Workspace domain-level content compliance rule that BCCs or forwards mail to an external address (UNC6508 exfiltration pattern).
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/chinese-hackers-abused-google-workspace.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1098.002
  - attack.t1114.003
logsource:
  product: gsuite
  service: admin
detection:
  selection:
    eventName:
      - 'CREATE_GMAIL_SETTING'
      - 'CHANGE_GMAIL_SETTING'
      - 'CREATE_APPLICATION_SETTING'
      - 'CHANGE_APPLICATION_SETTING'
  keyword:
    EventData|contains:
      - 'content_compliance'
      - 'contentCompliance'
  bcc:
    EventData|contains:
      - 'BCC'
      - 'Bcc'
      - 'bcc'
      - 'forward'
  external:
    EventData|contains: '@gmail.com'
  condition: selection and keyword and bcc and external
level: high
2806.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Changes.object) as object values(All_Changes.user) as user values(All_Changes.src) as src from datamodel=Change.All_Changes where All_Changes.vendor_product="Google Workspace" (All_Changes.action=created OR All_Changes.action=modified) (All_Changes.object_category="compliance_rule" OR All_Changes.object_category="content_compliance" OR All_Changes.change_type="GSUITE_ADMIN") by All_Changes.user All_Changes.object All_Changes.object_path | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | search object_path="*bcc*" OR object_path="*@gmail.com*" OR object_path="*forward*" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2806.datadog: source:gsuite @evt.name:(CREATE_GMAIL_SETTING OR CHANGE_GMAIL_SETTING OR CREATE_APPLICATION_SETTING OR CHANGE_APPLICATION_SETTING) @evt.outcome:success (@event.parameters.SETTING_NAME:*content_compliance* OR @event.parameters.SETTING_NAME:*ContentCompliance*) (@event.parameters.NEW_VALUE:*BCC* OR @event.parameters.NEW_VALUE:*bcc* OR @event.parameters.NEW_VALUE:*forward*) @event.parameters.NEW_VALUE:*@gmail.com*

description: Detects outbound network connections to tidio.cc or 84.201.6.54 used by the PushEngage / OptinMonster / TrustPulse tampered-script campaign disclosed by Sansec in June 2026.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/popular-wordpress-plugin-scripts.html
  - https://sansec.io/research
author: thn-usecases
date: 2026/06/15
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.t1041
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_ip:
    DestinationIp: '84.201.6.54'
  selection_dns:
    DestinationHostname|endswith: 'tidio.cc'
  condition: selection_ip or selection_dns
level: high
2826.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Traffic.src) as src values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dest_port from datamodel=Network_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_ip="84.201.6.54" OR All_Traffic.dest="tidio.cc" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.tidio.cc" by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_ip | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Resolution where Network_Resolution.DNS.query="tidio.cc" OR Network_Resolution.DNS.query="*.tidio.cc" by Network_Resolution.DNS.src Network_Resolution.DNS.query | `drop_dm_object_name(DNS)` ] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2826.datadog: (source:windows.defender OR source:windows.sysmon OR source:cloudtrail OR source:linux.auditd) AND (@DestinationHostname:(*tidio.cc OR *.tidio.cc) OR @RemoteUrl:(*tidio.cc*) OR @DestinationIp:84.201.6.54 OR @network.client.ip:84.201.6.54 OR @DomainName:(tidio.cc OR *.tidio.cc))
2826.falcon:
(#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 OR #event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP6 OR #event_simpleName=DnsRequest)
| (RemoteAddressIP4="84.201.6.54" OR RemoteAddressIP6="84.201.6.54" OR DomainName=/tidio\.cc$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, RemoteAddressIP4, DomainName], function=count())

author: thn-usecases

2830.sigma:
title: PHP process spawning shell from WordPress directory
id: 8e5d6f7a-4b3c-4d8e-9a2f-3c4d5e6f7a04
description: Detects php / php-fpm / php-cgi spawning a shell or download utility while running with wp-content/wp-admin/wp-includes in its path or command line — the canonical Sansec backdoor web-shell execution pattern.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/popular-wordpress-plugin-scripts.html
author: thn-usecases
date: 2026/06/15
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/php'
      - '/php-fpm'
      - '/php-cgi'
      - '\php.exe'
      - '\php-cgi.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
  selection_path:
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'wp-content'
      - 'wp-admin'
      - 'wp-includes'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_path
level: high
2830.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("php.exe","php-cgi.exe","php-fpm","php")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bash","sh","dash","zsh","nc","ncat","curl","wget")) by Processes.dest Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2830.datadog: (source:windows.sysmon OR source:linux.auditd) AND @ParentImage:(*\php.exe OR *\PHP.EXE OR */php OR */php-fpm OR */php-cgi) AND @Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR */bash OR */sh OR */dash OR */curl OR */wget OR *\curl.exe OR *\wget.exe) AND @ParentCommandLine:(*wp-content* OR *wp-admin* OR *wp-includes*)
2830.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^php(-cgi|-fpm)?(\.exe)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/(cmd\.exe|powershell\.exe|pwsh\.exe|[\\\/](bash|sh|dash|zsh|nc|ncat|curl|wget))(\.exe)?$/i
| regex("(?i)(wp-content|wp-admin|wp-includes)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

let LookbackHours = 2h;
let LoginWindowSec = 1800;

  union isfuzzy=true
    (W3CIISLog
     | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
     | where csUriStem startswith "/api/v1/admin/" or csUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/token/refresh"
     | where scStatus == 200
     | project AdminTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = cIP, AdminUri = csUriStem,
               UA = csUserAgent, Host = sSiteName),
    (AppServiceHTTPLogs
     | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
     | where CsUriStem startswith "/api/v1/admin/" or CsUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/token/refresh"
     | where ScStatus == 200
     | project AdminTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = CIp, AdminUri = CsUriStem,
               UA = UserAgent, Host = CsHost);
let LoginEvents =
  union isfuzzy=true
    (W3CIISLog
     | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours + 1h)
     | where csUriStem in ("/api/v1/login", "/api/v1/auth/login", "/login", "/oauth/token")
     | where scStatus == 200
     | project LoginTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = cIP),
    (AppServiceHTTPLogs
     | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours + 1h)
     | where CsUriStem in ("/api/v1/login", "/api/v1/auth/login", "/login", "/oauth/token")
     | where ScStatus == 200
     | project LoginTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = CIp);
AdminHits
| join kind=leftouter LoginEvents on SrcIp
| extend HasRecentLogin = isnotempty(LoginTime)
         and datetime_diff('second', AdminTime, LoginTime) between (0 .. LoginWindowSec)

references:
    - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c3qp-2ggw-xjg7
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/05
tags:
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.t1068
    - attack.t1078.003
    - cve.2026.47744
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection_path:
        cs-uri-stem|contains:
            - 'settings/team'
            - 'settings.team.index'
            - 'settings.team.role-permission'
            - 'settings.team.rolepermission'
            - '/livewire/update'
            - '/livewire/message/settings.team'
    condition: selection_path
falsepositives:

    - Internal QA/staging exercising the team settings page
level: medium

2977.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/applicationelb (or /aws/cloudfront/access-logs, /aws/wafv2) — point at whichever fronts the Shopper admin panel
fields @timestamp, request_url, request_verb, elb_status_code, client_ip, user_agent, target_processing_time
| filter (request_url like /settings\/team/

| where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ConnectionFound","ListeningConnectionCreated")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName matches regex @"(?i)^(python(3(\.\d+)?)?|ait-bsc)(\.exe)?$"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("ait-bsc","ait.core.bsc","ait_bsc","StreamCaptureManagerServer","bsc.yaml")

2979.sent:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let TraversalTokens = dynamic(["log_dir_path","file_name_pattern","..%2F","..%2f","..%5C","..%5c","%2e%2e","path=%2F","path=/etc","path=/root","path=/home","path=/var","path=/tmp","log_dir_path=/"]);
let IISHits = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where csMethod =~ "POST"
    | where csUriStem matches regex @"(?i)^/[^/]+/start$"
    | where csUriQuery has_any (TraversalTokens) or csUriStem has_any ("%2e%2e", "..")
    | project TimeGenerated, Host=Computer, SrcIp=tostring(cIP), DstPort=tostring(sPort), Uri=csUriStem, Detail=csUriQuery, UA=csUserAgent, Source="W3CIIS";
let CEFHits = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RequestMethod =~ "POST"
    | where RequestURL matches regex @"(?i)/[^/]+/start(\?|$)"
    | where Message has_any (TraversalTokens) or RequestURL has_any ("%2e%2e", "..")
    | project TimeGenerated, Host=coalesce(DestinationHostName, DestinationDnsDomain, DeviceExternalID), SrcIp=SourceIP, DstPort=tostring(DestinationPort), Uri=RequestURL, Detail=Message, UA=RequestClientApplication, Source="CEF";
let SyslogHits = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ProcessName has_any ("ait-bsc","ait_bsc","bsc","python","python3")
    | where SyslogMessage has "/start" and SyslogMessage has_any (TraversalTokens)
    | project TimeGenerated, Host=Computer, SrcIp=HostIP, DstPort="", Uri="/<name>/start", Detail=SyslogMessage, UA="", Source="Syslog";
union IISHits, CEFHits, SyslogHits
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated), Hits=count(), SampleDetail=any(Detail) by Host, SrcIp, Uri, Source
| order by LastSeen desc

description: Detects exploitation of CVE-2026-47731 — unauthenticated POST to the AIT-Core Binary Stream Capture /<name>/start endpoint carrying path-traversal-indicative form fields (log_dir_path, file_name_pattern, path) or %2e%2e/../ sequences that redirect the log_file write outside the configured root_log_directory.

detection:
    selection_method:

    selection_uri:
        cs-uri-stem|re: '(?i)^/[^/]+/start$'

        cs-uri-query|contains:
            - 'log_dir_path'
            - 'file_name_pattern'

// CVE-2026-47669 DbGate exploit chain via WAF/proxy logs in CommonSecurityLog
let ExploitEndpoints = dynamic(["/api/archive/unzip","/api/archive/save-uploaded-zip","/api/uploads/upload","/api/auth/login"]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where RequestMethod =~ "POST"
| where RequestURL has_any (ExploitEndpoints)
| extend Endpoint = case(
    RequestURL has "/api/archive/unzip", "unzip",
    RequestURL has "/api/archive/save-uploaded-zip", "save-uploaded-zip",
    RequestURL has "/api/uploads/upload", "upload",
    RequestURL has "/api/auth/login", "login",
    "other")
| summarize EndpointsHit = make_set(Endpoint),
            UrlSamples = make_set(RequestURL, 10),
            UASet = make_set(RequestClientApplication),
            ReqCount = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by SourceIP, DestinationHostName, DestinationIP
| where array_length(EndpointsHit) >= 2
    and (set_has_element(EndpointsHit, "unzip") or set_has_element(EndpointsHit, "save-uploaded-zip"))
| order by LastSeen desc
